definitions.explanation: Describes a company or organization that is owned or controlled by foreign capital. In Japan, this typically refers to the Japanese branches or subsidiaries of multinational corporations.

examples.japanese: {外資系|がいしけい}{企業|きぎょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work at a foreign-affiliated company.

examples.japanese: {外資系|がいしけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: Foreign-owned hotels have a different level of service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日系|にっけい}{企業|きぎょう}→日系企業：16650_nikkeikigyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{外資系|がいしけい}コンサルティング{会社|がいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She changed jobs from a Japanese company to a foreign-affiliated consulting firm.

notes:
Composed of {外資|がいし} (foreign capital) + ⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧ (affiliated, type).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外資系|がいしけい}{企業|きぎょう}: foreign-affiliated company
- {外資系|がいしけい}⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧: foreign bank
- {外資系|がいしけい}⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧: foreign-owned hotel
- {外資系|がいしけい}コンサルティング: foreign consulting firm

USAGE:
In Japanese business culture, {外資系|がいしけい} companies are associated with higher salaries, performance-based evaluation, more flexible work styles, and English-language requirements. The term is frequently used in job-hunting contexts. Contrasts with ⟦{日系|にっけい}→日系：12956_nikkei⟧ (Japanese-affiliated) and ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧ (domestic company).
